main.description: The counterparty's co-signature on an offer or amendment — the moment terms become binding (AGREED), or an amendment takes effect. Because `subject` is a strongRef (which pins the exact content id), terms can't be silently changed after acceptance: any change has to come back as a new, separately-accepted amendment. Author is the accepter (repo owner). Written to the accepter's repo.

subject.description: The org.buildguild.offer or org.buildguild.amendment being co-signed (pinned by content id).

fetched.description: Optional git commit/tree sha the accepter has fetched and is acknowledging receipt of — forecloses 'I never received it' as a later defense (see org.buildguild.delivery).
